title: 6.00 — Lecture 1: Computer Science and Python Introduction
openai_review: OpenAI covers more, but its final arithmetic section ends with a malformed bullet.
local_review: Local guides often emphasize course logistics and omit practical Python examples.

title: 6.034 — Lecture 1: Introduction and Scope
openai_review: Better connections between representations, constraints, and search.
local_review: The reviewed 1.5B river-crossing solution is broken. The 7B puts some ordinary prose in code blocks.

title: 6.034 — Lecture 4: Search: Depth-First, Hill Climbing, Beam
openai_review: Explains algorithm behavior, queue implementation, and lecture-specific demonstrations.
local_review: The first completed 14B guide is mainly a short overview; longer 7B runs can repeat topics.

title: 6.034 — Lecture 5: Search: Optimal, Branch and Bound, A*
openai_review: Separates search improvements and explains admissibility versus consistency.
local_review: Local guides compress important distinctions into broad statements and short lists.

title: 6.034 — Lecture 6: Search: Games, Minimax, and Alpha-Beta
openai_review: Clear progression through evaluation, minimax, pruning, and progressive deepening.
local_review: The reviewed 14B guide has two Progressive Deepening topics. The 7B repeats exhaustive-search material.

title: 6.034 — Lecture 10: Introduction to Learning, Nearest Neighbors
openai_review: Retains more of the robotic-arm example, cosine similarity, and limitations.
local_review: Local guides retain some examples but often substitute generic bullets for explanations.

title: 6.034 — Lecture 11: Learning: Identification Trees, Disorder
openai_review: Develops entropy, weighted disorder, and numeric threshold selection.
local_review: The 14B includes useful formulas with less explanation. The reviewed 1.5B guide is only about 267 words.

title: 6.034 — Lecture 12A: Neural Nets
openai_review: Better explanation of derivatives and reuse of intermediate computations.
local_review: The 14B has useful sigmoid material, but incorrectly suggests integrating a bias makes the activation continuous.

title: 6.034 — Lecture 12B: Deep Neural Nets
openai_review: Preserves concrete image-recognition examples and what their failures illustrate.
local_review: The 14B is organized but more generic. The 7B has malformed mathematical formatting.

title: 6.034 — Lecture 16: Learning: Support Vector Machines
openai_review: A fuller mathematical progression through the margin, Lagrangian, and dot-product decision rule.
local_review: The 14B summarizes much of the derivation. The reviewed 7B guide gives an incorrect signed classification constraint.
